title: eval-harness: add prompt-set regression CI hook and quality gating integration
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: Prevent prompt-set regressions from reaching production by integrating the eval-harness prompt regression checks as a CI hook and wiring results into the existing quality gating pipeline. This PR introduces a lightweight CI hook that runs a subset of critical prompt-set evaluations on PRs touching model-serving, prompt templates, or eval datasets. The hook posts a summary report, exits non-zero on regression beyond configured thresholds, and annotates the PR with a permalink to the full eval run. Changes: 1) CI hook script and job: eval-harness/ci/hooks/prompt_regression_check.py and .github/workflows/prompt_regression.yml 2) Eval runner improvements: eval-harness/pkgs/runner/fast_eval.py - add incremental caching and deterministic seeding for reproducible short runs 3) Quality gating integration: redwood/observability/gating/integrations/eval_hook_connector.py - new light integration that converts eval metrics into the gating service format 4) Docs: redwood-docs/docs/evals/gating.md - usage and config examples 5) Tests: eval-harness/tests/test_ci_hook.py and small fixtures under eval-harness/tests/fixtures/ The description below includes the checklist and notes about thresholds and rerun behavior. Checklist: - [x] Add CI workflow and hook script - [x] Add incremental eval path for quick runs (<=30s) - [x] Add gating integration and mapping for delta thresholds - [x] Unit tests for hook and integration - [x] Docs update with example configuration Runtime notes: the hook selects a canonical prompt-set (prompt-criticals-v2) and runs a 200-example smoke set using a cached model snapshot. Thresholds are configurable via .github/eval_config.yml; default behavior is to fail on >2% drop in top-line accuracy or >5% drop in ROUGE for summary prompts. On first failure the hook will annotate the PR and post the full eval job link to build artifacts; maintainer can re-run with [rerun-eval] comment which triggers the eval job via GitHub Actions workflow_dispatch. Related: builds on prior eval-harness CI work (see ENG-4123) and addresses customer-facing regressions caught in recent postmortem (INC-2024-09).

release_notes: Add CI hook to run prompt-set regressions and integrate results into quality gating. Default thresholds and config added; workflow is opt-out for docs-only changes.
notes: This PR targets the most common regression vector for prompt drift and provides a fast feedback loop for engineers. Follow-up work: (1) add waveform/latency smoke checks for model-serving infra (ENG-5120), (2) expand gating metrics to include hallucination score and eval intersection tests.
